ai.sum: Emine Erdogan marked Azerbaijan's Victory Day and honoured those who died in the 2020 Karabakh war during a visit with President Erdogan.

items.title: Cop31 must deliver climate progress that people can see is real, host says
items.summary: High-stakes talks involving 190 countries begin on Monday as world grapples with El Niño supercharged by fossil fuels The Cop31 summit must produce progress, “a tangible outcome ... that people can see is real”, its host has said as scores of world leaders and representatives of close to 190 countries gather in Turkey for the UN climate talks. The high-stakes meeting begins on Monday, as countries around the world grapple with the strongest El Niño weather system on record…

ai.sum: The host of COP31 in Turkey said the summit must deliver visible climate progress as around 190 countries gather for talks starting Monday.

items.title: Harşit Zaferi'nin 109. yıl dönümü dolayısıyla Gümüşhane'de anma töreni düzenlendi
items.summary: Anma törenine Kara Kuvvetleri Komutanı Orgeneral Metin Tokel, Gümüşhane Valisi Cevdet Atay, AK Parti Gümüşhane Milletvekili Celalettin Köse ve MHP Gümüşhane Milletvekili Musa Küçük katıldı.

ai.sum: A commemoration marking the 109th anniversary of the Harşit Victory was held in Gümüşhane with army and local officials attending.
ai.title_en: Commemoration held in Gümüşhane for the 109th anniversary of the Harşit Victory

items.title: Iran dismisses US Iron Gate task force as plan that 'will remain on paper'

ai.sum: Iran dismisses the US Iron Gate task force as a plan that will remain on paper.

items.title: Egypt reopens Tripoli embassy after 12 years and raises concerns over Turkey-Libya maritime deal
items.summary: Egypt is seeking closer ties with Libya’s western government after years of backing its eastern rival. Talks in Tripoli covered energy projects and Egypt’s objections to Libya’s maritime deal with Turkey.

ai.sum: Egypt reopened its Tripoli embassy after 12 years and raised objections to Libya's maritime deal with Türkiye during talks with the western government.

ai.sum: Former UK foreign secretary David Lammy urged the Home Office to act over rising refusals of permanent residency for Turkish nationals.

items.title: Türkiye supports Azerbaijan's efforts for lasting peace in South Caucasus: Erdogan

ai.sum: Erdoğan said Türkiye supports Azerbaijan's efforts for lasting peace in the South Caucasus and praised Karabakh reconstruction.

items.title: Türk Telekom COP31'in teknoloji altyapısının sorumluluğunu üstlendi
items.summary: Türk Telekom, COP31'in teknoloji altyapısını uçtan uca üstlenerek ulusal ve uluslararası katılımcılar, ülke delegasyonları, basın mensupları ve ziyaretçilerin iletişim ihtiyaçlarını karşılayacak kapsamlı bir dijital altyapı kurdu.

ai.sum: Türk Telekom has built an end-to-end digital infrastructure to meet communication needs at COP31 in Antalya.
